name: Derived From Installation
description: The App installation whose grant a collection_scope was derived from — the configuration the run read, at the moment it read it. Absent in a PAT-only run, where there is no installation to derive from; absent also when the installation inventory could not be read, so the edge is never a guess. The scope is operation-side history and the installation is declaration-side configuration: this edge is the join between what was granted and what one run could therefore see (github-core#145).
